calculation.description: Three-session mean of the negative close-location score; higher values represent closes nearer the low of the daily range and are expected to predict stronger next-observation cross-sectional returns.

validation.regime_notes: Date-aligned completed daily bars across the 15 tradable cross-asset instruments. Daily IC is positive in 2020-22 (0.0542), 2023-24 (0.0413), and 2025-26 (0.0695), with 1,792 observations and conservative minimum cross-section of eight. Predictive strength decays with horizon; coverage is reduced by the three-bar warm-up and asynchronous histories. Correlation metadata retains the previously audited maximum library correlation of 0.3297 pending the deterministic post-Miner recomputation.
